title: AI Broke Cybersecurity. Visual Programming Can Fix It.
description: This content discusses the cybersecurity challenges introduced by AI-generated code, including rapid code generation outpacing human review, unreliable runtime threat detection due to limited observability, and slow patching processes. It proposes a visual programming language called Pipe as a solution to improve code review, observability, and patching speed by enabling visual logic representation and runtime observability. The discussion is conceptual and does not describe a specific vulnerability or exploit.
